name: vocabolario-pwa
description: Ripasso quotidiano del vocabolario giapponese, tre volte al giorno.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:static && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:static: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html sw.js manifest.webmanifest dist/ && cp -R icons dist/
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory dist
